environment_cpu.json.capture: post-run environment observation before CuPy finished installing; exact interpreter and package versions retained in install logs

per_run_environment.json: Each subsequent run has its own environment.json; tdl_baseline records failed loader, retry records cuFFT LD_LIBRARY_PATH repair.
timing: Wall time includes initialization and analysis; CPU/GPU memory are separately measured; GPU peak is sampled every two seconds, not exact hardware high-water mark.
